userDirection: 只要有优化的，不影响兼容性的改进，都默认开启
adoptionPolicy: Adopt supported positive real-scene improvements and provable redundant CPU/work removal after compatibility checks; individual adoption does not require meeting the whole-product original+50% or zero-stutter goal. Preserve negative, unproven and incompatible candidates as disabled.

newDefaults.change: Exact union of dense same-color opaque integer point squares; unsupported batches retain the complete legacy path.
Compute the unchanged order-sensitive recording hash only when requested.
Reuse immutable CPU shader descriptions; keep independent pipelines, binding storage and native retirement.
Recycle one bounded unpublished duplicate page with exact dirty-prefix clearing; never recycle canonical or published storage.
Avoid short presentation parks; use a larger final spin interval, with additional CPU cost.
Bounded pre-input wait for a newly published immutable frame; may add up to1.5ms of input processing wait and CPU use.
Reuse the immutable paint when the effective texture effect is unchanged.
Share already immutable unchanged command values while detaching the published list and restoring all resource dependencies.
Reuse a private unstored lookup probe and retain detached canonical text mesh keys.
Cache the identical family/style string for immutable typeface values.
Reuse private derived-font and metrics preparation without changing label geometry.
Publish ordered numeric texture batches for GPU map cells; subordinate rect batches now inherit their existing enabled policy.
Batch black fog rectangles and texture masks in their original order, preserving alpha and UV.
Reset previously used meshes and finish currently used meshes instead of walking inactive mesh caches.
Render each installed map content version once instead of retaining the redundant redraw compensation.

previouslyEnabled: Frozen content reuse with complete dependency/version/lifetime restoration
Immutable map-atlas CPU pixels and upload views
Existing pixel/upload/freeze scratch pools and metadata/mesh reuse

validation.spriteControllerFailure: V1 required a CPU template cache log from a sprite-only path that does not load that class; raw failure preserved, no sprite retry.
validation.gpuScope: Memory-only window adapter, no NSWindow/audio/input. Main context4; these inherited readback passes use default1 sample and tolerance3, not an all-frame exact/MSAA4 claim. Fifteen overrides absent does not mean every branch was exercised.
validation.coreV2Resolution: Three test-fixture casts assumed unbatched representation. Read the complete ordered rectangles/raw floatbits/paint/state and assert a single-quad texture batch. Product behavior and semantic assertions were not relaxed; finalV3 passed.

realDefaultPair.lowerRatePreserved: Both measured around119freshHz despite configured300; keep these valid runs and do not select old240Hz references or infer uncapped headroom.

performanceLimit: Do not add individual historical percentages. No stable whole-product+50% or stutter-free claim; no new matched official-original reference was run.
